propositions: Root disk on autodeploy host fills to 92-96% and remains pinned because the no-op path (triggered every ~2 min on quiescent main) skips docker cache pruning entirely, leaving garbage unclaimed between deploys.
The autodeploy no-op early exit (line 228) must invoke pressure-triggered, throttled reclamation to fill the gap left by pruning only on deploy/backoff paths.
The existing prune_docker_caches() function definition at line 245 must be relocated above line 228 so it is in scope when called from the no-op path.
A pressure prune fires only when root disk usage is >= DISK_PRESSURE_PCT (default 80%) AND the throttle window (default 600s) has elapsed, preventing churn while maintaining a 5GB warm cache.
A prune failure on the pressure path logs non-fatally and does not alter autodeploy's exit code or the script's control flow.
